fr.elements: Main Residence; Circular Driveway; Access Drive; Front Driveway; Open Terrain; Landscaped Area; Detached Structure
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Circular Driveway; Open Terrain
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the road entrance to the access drive so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to define the turn-in point at night or in low visibility conditions.
• Post a clearly visible property map or site diagram near the road entrance showing the location of the main residence and detached structure.
• Keep the full length of the access drive clear of parked vehicles so responding units can reach the circular driveway without stopping.
• Maintain the access drive width along its entire length to allow two emergency vehicles to pass or one large vehicle to navigate without leaving the roadway.
• Trim any trees or shrubs along the access drive that hang low enough to obstruct a fire engine or ladder truck.
• Keep the circular driveway clear of vehicles, equipment, and stored materials so arriving units can position without repositioning other apparatus.
• Mark a designated turnaround or staging area on the property so responders arriving in large vehicles have a known exit path without backing a long distance.
• Identify the detached structure with a clearly visible address or unit marker so responders can distinguish it from the main residence on arrival.
• Keep a gate, if present at the single access point, unlocked or equipped with a knox box or standard emergency access lock.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Open Terrain; Scattered Trees; Vegetation Near Structure; Long Driveway; Vegetation Along Driveway; Grass Cover; Scattered Shrubs; Limited Turnaround Area; Open Green Space; Scattered Trees; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly next to the structure on all sides.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure to increase open space between their canopies and the building.
• Clear grass and low vegetation from the area immediately surrounding the structure.
• Remove or cut back shrubs and tall grass growing along the edges of the driveway.
• Trim tree branches that overhang or lean over the driveway to keep the full width and height clear for vehicle access.
• Keep the driveway surface clear of fallen branches, leaves, and dry plant material that could block access.
• Create a wider cleared area near the end of the driveway to allow emergency vehicles to turn around or reposition.
• Cut grass in open areas close to the structure before it dries out seasonally.
• Maintain separation between scattered shrub clusters and the structure by removing shrubs that have grown into the clear zone around the building.
